name: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited
summary: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited, a precision engineering solutions company, manufactures and sells tooling, precision components, electromechanical turnkey systems, and mechanical assemblies. The company operates through two segments, Aero-Tooling/MRO Tooling; and Precision Components and Assemblies. It offers Aero and MRO tooling products, such as engine stands and transportation systems, engine lifting and balancing equipment, turbine assembly fixtures, hydraulic tooling solutions, high-precision drilling jigs and fixtures, and airframe assembly tooling.
